query: I have a 51-year-old female with suspected ACS. Among female ACS admissions age 46–56, what are counts, percentages, and mean hospital length of stay for first hs‑TnT: Normal, Borderline, Myocardial Injury?
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_admissions, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(p.anchor_year)) BETWEEN 46 AND 56 THEN a.hadm_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS proportion_of_eligible_admissions, AVG(a.los) AS average_length_of_stay FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(p.anchor_year)) BETWEEN 46 AND 56 AND p.suspected_acso = 'Y' AND p.anchor_year_group = 'ACS' AND p.anchor_year_group_description = 'Female ACS' AND p.anchor_year_group_description_2 = 'ACS'
